topic: Data dataset date range discrepancy check
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on running and verifying an aggregated dataset for a meeting. A key issue was identified regarding the date range: someone noted that the data provided to another participant showed null values until November 23rd, while actual data existed from October 28th–29th. It was confirmed that the necessary data for November is available on the stage environment. The final exchange clarified that an incorrect dataset had been sent.
decisions: An aggregated version of the dataset needs to be run and reviewed before a meeting at 15:30.
action_items: Review the correct, comprehensive dataset covering all necessary dates (including October 28th–29th) for the meeting.
